description: Every IERS-issued end-of-day UTC leap-second is rejected with weekday_mismatch because _check_weekday validates the post-rollover date against the pre-rollover weekday name. Verified live against 7 real historical leap-seconds: 1994-06-30, 1995-12-31, 2005-12-31, 2008-12-31, 2012-06-30, 2015-06-30, 2016-12-31 — all raise InvalidFormat(weekday_mismatch). Mid-day :60 (e.g. 08:49:60) parses correctly, confirming the bug is specifically the ordering of rollover-then-weekday-check. Fix: check weekday of the pre-rollover date in _parse_imf/_parse_rfc850 before _build_datetime rolls the leap-second (or skip the weekday check when _build_datetime returned a _LeapSecondDatetime).
